summary: Detected Neo4j data loss (14614 to 49 nodes) during migration run. Reset checkpoint and restarted migration from session 0.

incident.description: Migration had been running 6h (PID 83636, started 12:14 MDT). Accumulated 14614 nodes (5289 Facts, 412 Episodes) across 280 sessions. Between 18:12-18:15 MDT, data was deleted - only 49 nodes remained. Root cause: likely external MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n or docker volume recreation. Checkpoint marked 280 sessions complete but their data was gone.
incident.data_lost: 14614 nodes (5289 Facts, 5286 Observations, 1278 Literals, 1176 Entities, 1173 Aliases, 412 Episodes)
incident.recovery: Backed up broken checkpoint to /tmp/ferrite-migration-checkpoint.bak.json. Reset checkpoint to empty. Restarted migration (PID 56824). Found 1004 sessions. Processing from session 1.

migration.estimated_duration: ~18-21h at 30s per episode, ~2 episodes per session

fixes_applied: Verified Neo4j schema intact (5 constraints, 22 indexes)
